📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

6. Speculative Appetite?

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

8. Energy Trend?
Energy is in CORRECTION: XLE (1W: -2.24% | 1M: +5.09%). Natural gas remains weak, with UNG (1W: -5.29% | 1M: -13.46%) BELOW TREND.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed weakness: SPY (1W: -1.99% | 1M: -2.64%) and XLK (1W: -6.85% | 1M: -12.15%) are BELOW TREND; VXX (1W: +4.19% | 1M: +9.77%) is ABOVE TREND. TLT (1W: -0.64% | 1M: +5.19%) is in CORRECTION, a limited timeframe divergence rather than a broad core-ETF divergence.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Stay selective and preserve a neutral stance: defensive-sector ETFs XLP (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +9.76%) and XLV (1W: +2.70% | 1M: +9.95%) show relative strength, while XLK (1W: -6.85% | 1M: -12.15%) and QQQ (1W: -4.99% | 1M: -9.38%) are BELOW TREND. Style leadership is unclear; the Tech/Financials ratio is flat (1W: 0.00% | 1M: 0.00%).

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: If breadth holds at 9/11, monitor continued strength in XLV (1W: +2.70% | 1M: +9.95%), ABOVE TREND.
BEARISH: If technology weakness broadens, watch XLK (1W: -6.85% | 1M: -12.15%), BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: If oil’s monthly strength resumes, monitor BNO (1W: -5.11% | 1M: +7.58%), in CORRECTION.
BEARISH: If industrial-demand signals weaken further, watch CPER (1W: -3.85% | 1M: -3.39%), BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
No reliable absolute price or ratio levels are supplied. Monitor sector breadth, the flat HYG/LQD ratio (1W: 0.00% | 1M: 0.00%), and whether VXX (1W: +4.19% | 1M: +9.77%) remains ABOVE TREND.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive, indicating Broad strength but mixed risk signals. Defensive sectors are showing relative strength, while technology is weak and style leadership remains unclear. Monitor rising VXX (1W: +4.19% | 1M: +9.77%) against broad sector breadth for signs of a deeper divergence.
